_source: Updated 2026-10-28 (launch day) to reconcile with the 2026-10-27 tracker sync: 54 live partners. Delta vs 2026-10-26 (53 / 37574): +1 partner (Zapier, newly Live), +$0 - Zapier is a free 2-week trial with no CAN-exclusive dollar savings (per Avi 10/7/26, v:null in cansw-data), so it joins the count like the uncapped-earn rows but never enters the total. total_value_exact stays 37574; display string stays $37,000+. Uncapped-earn rows (ShopYourLikes, Insense, TopFan) still count as live partners with no dollar contribution. Largest single discount remains $7,200 (CreatorCare); smallest $30 (Elevate.io). total_value_exact is required - without it the widget stat tile silently falls back to the rounded figure. segments/segments_updated untouched (still the 2026-09-10 out-of-band write at 50 partners; needs its own refresh). 2026-10-28 (second edit, out of band): Greenroom Legal's ceiling corrected 2000 -> 3200 after the partner confirmed the figure by email on 10/27 (the earlier 2000 omitted the 5%-off-next-three-hourly-projects tier); ceiling total 37574 -> 38774, which moves the rounded display from $37,000+ to $38,000+. Note this delta was applied by hand, not recomputed by the parser - the next parser run should confirm 38774. Greenroom's name was also corrected to the partner's required spelling (lowercase r) in cansw-data.json, its logos map, segments.json and segments-live.json.
